how_to_apply: Download the prescribed proforma (Annexure-I) from www.nch.org.in under 'What is new' and 'Information-Recruitment'.
Apply through proper channel; submit a separate application for each post.
Enclose passport size photograph, copies of certificates of qualification and experience, and recent vigilance clearance.
Send the application by post to the Secretary, National Commission for Homoeopathy (NCH), Janakpuri, New Delhi-110058.
Email a scanned copy to [email protected]; the scanned copy is treated as the final application.
Both physical and emailed copies must reach within 30 days from publication in the Employment News.
Make sure it reaches by 18 December 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for NCH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 18 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NCH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 8 vacancies: 3 Deputy Secretary, 1 Deputy Legal Adviser, 1 Under Secretary, 3 Section Officer.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for NCH Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Annexure-I of the notice; also on www.nch.org.in under 'What is new' and 'Information-Recruitment') and send it to Secretary, National Commission for Homoeopathy (NCH), No. 61-65, Institutional Area, Opp. D Block, Janakpuri, New Delhi-110058, by by post, with a scanned copy by email, to reach by 18 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 56 years (as on the closing date of receipt of applications).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Level 12 in 7th CPC, Rs. 78800-209200 for Deputy Secretary, Level 12 in 7th CPC, Rs. 78800-209200 for Deputy Legal Adviser, Level 11 in 7th CPC, Rs. 67700-208700 for Under Secretary, Level 08 in 7th CPC, Rs. 47600-151100 for Section Officer.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Officers of Central/State Governments, UTs, Autonomous or Statutory organisations, Public Undertakings, Universities or recognized Research Institutes holding analogous posts or with the prescribed regular service in the feeder pay level, or with a bachelor's degree (law degree for Deputy Legal Adviser) and the prescribed years of experience. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Open to Indian nationals. Applications must come through proper channel. Officers of Central/State Governments, UTs, Autonomous or Statutory organisations, PSUs, Universities or recognized Research Institutes may apply. Qualifications and experience will be verified with original certificates.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Department officers in the feeder category who are in the direct line of promotion are not eligible for deputation. Deputationists are not eligible for appointment by promotion.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Assessment of Curriculum Vitae and supporting documents by the Selection Committee. Curriculum Vitae and supporting documents assessed by the Selection Committee at the time of selection.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Deputation period, including immediately preceding ex-cadre deputation, shall ordinarily not exceed three years.
